children: WASHINGTON (dpa-AFX) - Super Micro Computer Inc. (SMCI) revealed a profit for its first quarter that Increases, from last year
The company's bottom line came in at $1.594 billion, or $1.75 per share.  This compares with $168.285 million, or $0.26 per share, last year.
Excluding items, Super Micro Computer Inc. reported adjusted earnings of $1.380 billion or $1.81 per share for the period.
The company's revenue for the period rose 297.5% to $19.945 billion from $5.017 billion last year.
Super Micro Computer Inc. earnings at a glance (GAAP) :
Next quarter revenue guidance: $ 19.5 B To $ 21.5 B
Full year revenue guidance: $ 72.0 B To $ 82.0 B
